Most of the gym equipment is frequently under maintenance, making it difficult to complete a proper workout. It’s frustrating to visit a gym and find key machines unavailable almost every time.
The situation in the bathrooms is even worse. There is a complete lack of cleanliness, no geyser for hot water, and the changing area is extremely inadequate and inconvenient. These are basic facilities that any gym should provide, especially one that positions itself as a premium fitness brand.

Regards
Nitin Mendon

If you want a trainer who is not just a rep-counter but a true teacher and motivator, you must train with Nomaan. My perspective on training has completely changed for the better!
